identity: A low-curve Boros token aggro deck that treats Superfriends as an accelerant rather than a plan. Jaya, Fiery Negotiator is the archetype's real engine here - '+1: Create a 1/1 red Monk creature token with prowess' adds a body every turn, and Urza Assembles the Titans chapter III turns that into two Monks per turn. Underneath sits a shell that makes two or three bodies per card (Resolute Reinforcements, Argivian Cavalier, kicked Keldon Strike Team) with Valiant Veteran as a turn-2 anthem over the Soldier tokens and Squee, Dubious Monarch adding a free hasty Goblin on every attack, and it converts that width to lethal with kicked Heroic Charge's trample. Average mana value is 2.61 with only five cards at MV 4 or above. Stated plainly: the deck is built to win by turn 7 WITHOUT drawing Urza - the Saga is upside on an already-lethal board, not a prerequisite, and both grill agents independently flagged that all three of its chapters key off a 2-card denominator.

restrictions.base_pool: cube_mainboard of dominaria-united---main-set only; every card verified by exact-name match against the working pool cache and independently re-verified by the Phase 9 Challenger (zero phantoms).
restrictions.common_uncommon_max_2: PASS - no common or uncommon exceeds 2 copies across mainboard + sideboard combined. Two names sit exactly at the cap by spanning boards: Hurloon Battle Hymn (1 MB + 1 SB) and Smash to Dust (1 MB + 1 SB).
restrictions.rare_mythic_max_1_each: PASS - Urza Assembles the Titans, Valiant Veteran, Squee Dubious Monarch, Jaya, Karn are 1 copy each.
restrictions.rare_mythic_total_max_5: PASS - exactly 5: Urza Assembles the Titans (rare), Valiant Veteran (rare), Squee, Dubious Monarch (rare), Jaya, Fiery Negotiator (mythic), Karn, Living Legacy (mythic). Zero rare/mythic cards in the sideboard. Plaza of Heroes previously held the fifth slot and was cut in the Phase 9 repair.
restrictions.basics: Plains x6, Mountain x7 - format-supplied, exempt from copy limits.
restrictions.colour_legality: PASS - every nonland card returns a usable mode from effective_cost.best_mode(card, ['W','R'], []). Four cards print RW identities that come from kickers, and in this deck BOTH halves of every one are core colours, so all four kickers are fully payable: Keldon Strike Team (Kicker {1}{W}), Hurloon Battle Hymn (Kicker {W}), Heroic Charge (Kicker {1}{R}), and Cleaving Skyrider in the sideboard (Kicker {2}{R}). Unlike the other three builds, this deck has no card that is legal only through a declined kicker.

mainboard.name: Urza Assembles the Titans
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Scry 4, then you may reveal the top card of your library. If a planeswalker card is revealed this way, put it into your hand.
II — You may put a planeswalker card with mana value 6 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.
III — You may activate the loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control twice this turn rather than only once.

mainboard.name: Karn, Living Legacy
mainboard.oracle_text:
+1: Create a tapped Powerstone token. (It's an artifact with "{T}: Add {C}. This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.")
−1: Pay any amount of mana. Look at that many cards from the top of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
−7: You get an emblem with "Tap an untapped artifact you control: This emblem deals 1 damage to any target."

mainboard.name: Jaya, Fiery Negotiator
mainboard.oracle_text:
+1: Create a 1/1 red Monk creature token with prowess.
−1: Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
−2: Choose target creature an opponent controls. Whenever you attack this turn, Jaya deals damage equal to the number of attacking creatures to that creature.
−8: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy it twice. You may choose new targets for the copies."

sideboard.name: Griffin Protector
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against any deck with fliers. This is the most important sideboard slot in the deck: the mainboard contains ZERO flying blockers - Phoenix Chick has 'Flying' but also 'This creature can't block'. 'Flying / Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn' also grows off the 11-body token floor, so it blocks in the air and attacks in the air.
sideboard.answers: evasion (51 cards, 20.65% - the cube's LARGEST threat class)

sideboard.name: Destroy Evil
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
• Destroy target enchantment.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against enchantment decks and against fat ground blockers. The mainboard has no enchantment answer at all, and the toughness-4-or-greater mode covers exactly the creatures Lightning Strike's 3 damage cannot kill.

sideboard.name: Citizen's Arrest
sideboard.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against a deck with one creature this deck cannot attack through, and against any deck playing planeswalkers. Exile-based, so it beats indestructible and death triggers.

sideboard.name: Cleaving Skyrider
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flash
Kicker {2}{R} (You may pay an additional {2}{R} as you cast this spell.)
Flying
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
sideboard.when_to_board: In when the opponent can profitably block a wide ground team. 'Flash / Kicker {2}{R} / Flying / When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of attacking creatures.' Both halves are core colours, and Flash means it can be cast MID-COMBAT so X counts the whole attack; 'any target' lets X go to the face.
sideboard.answers: stalled ground boards / the last chunk of life

sideboard.name: Captain's Call
sideboard.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
sideboard.when_to_board: Reduced to a single copy after the Phase 9 grill pointed out that spending 2 slots on the cube's smallest threat class - with a MV-4 board-neutral sorcery, in a build selected on curve grounds - was inconsistent. Kept as one copy because 'Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens' rebuilds from a completely empty board and all three are Soldiers that Valiant Veteran immediately makes 2/2s.

sideboard.name: Hurloon Battle Hymn
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {W} (You may pay an additional {W} as you cast this spell.)
Hurloon Battle Hymn deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was kicked, you gain 4 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Second copy in when the game is a damage race. Kicked for a total of {2}{R}{W} it is 4 damage to a creature or planeswalker AND 4 life for you. NOTE the damage cannot go to the face - the oracle reads 'target creature or planeswalker' - so this swings a race by killing an attacker and gaining life, not by burning the opponent.

sideboard.name: Smash to Dust
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target artifact.
• Destroy target creature with defender.
• Smash to Dust deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
sideboard.when_to_board: Second copy in against artifact decks and against opposing token boards; mode 3 deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control, which is one-sided.
